report.explanation: Alert observations show 12 checkout requests all HTTP 200 with durations 47-297ms; p95 metric of 412ms is modest and no 502s (increase=0). Traces show successful end-to-end checkout with healthy postgres pool (size=1, idle=1) and fast redis. No failure, error, or saturation signal is present, so no bounded root cause can be established. Operator hypothesis is contradicted by healthy telemetry; handing off for human review with the missing evidence listed.
missing_evidence: No error/failure telemetry: all observed checkout requests returned 200; need evidence of actual failure or SLO breach to substantiate any root cause.
Gateway logs (ev-...-gw-logs) were excluded from context; need them to check for errors, timeouts, or retries.
No downstream dependency latency/error metrics for order, payment, inventory, redis, postgres to test downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion.
No memory-retention time series across services to evaluate memory-leak; single snapshots (5-7MB vs 32MB limit) are within limits.
No deployment records or version-change facts to evaluate bad-configuration or deployment-caused latency.
